description: Owned Solar. No Lease, No Loan! Discover easy, resort-like living in the unmatched Summit Villas, a gated 55+ community of only 12 custom homes. This beautiful home offers approximately 2,209 square feet with abundant flexible-use spaces designed for comfortable living.
